description: Bumps the digest of the Python base in Dockerfile and the SHA-pinned actions in the build workflow. Nothing merges itself; see README.md.

packageRules.description: The Python base is named by its tag and pinned by digest, so a refreshed 3.12-slim-trixie is a digest update. A new Python minor or major in the tag is a toolchain move and waits on the Dependency Dashboard.
